title: Cover run_concurrently's normal preparation and start boundary
outcome: A behavioral success-path test exercises run_concurrently's shared start boundary, alongside its existing unwind regressions.
acceptance: A test calls run_concurrently itself and observes that job invocation follows preparation of all intended job inputs, while retaining actual concurrent workers and their completed results.

Coverage verifies observable behavior without pinning helper text or structure, adding real sleeps or timeout-expiry waits, or claiming schedule-independent simultaneous execution from a readiness signal.
